concepts.label: Archaeopteryx
concepts.learning_takeaway: Archaeopteryx fossils combine feather impressions with teeth and a long bony tail.
concepts.card: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur with teeth and a long bony tail, combining birdlike feathers with features of other dinosaurs.
concepts.original_description: genus of early bird-like dinosaur

evidence.note: Fossil evidence identifies the mixed anatomical features.

relations.note: The museum interprets its fossils through paleontology.

imported_records.description: genus of early bird-like dinosaur

concepts.label: Distillation
concepts.learning_takeaway: Distillation boils a liquid and condenses its vapor elsewhere to separate sufficiently different components.
concepts.card: Distillation separates suitable liquid mixtures by boiling them and condensing vapor elsewhere; components need sufficiently different boiling behavior for effective separation.
concepts.original_description: method of separating mixtures based on differences in volatility of components in a boiling liquid mixture

evidence.note: Boiling, condensation and mixture limitations are explicit.

relations.note: The text explicitly describes distillation as a liquid purification and mixture-separation method.

imported_records.description: method of separating mixtures based on differences in volatility of components in a boiling liquid mixture
method of separating mixtures based on differences in volatility of components in a boiling liquid mixture

concepts.learning_takeaway: Brown dwarfs form from collapsing gas but lack enough mass to sustain hydrogen fusion in their cores.
concepts.card: Brown dwarfs form from collapsing gas but lack enough mass to sustain hydrogen fusion in their cores.

concepts.label: Inflammation
concepts.learning_takeaway: Inflammation normally recruits repair responses to damaged tissue, but persistent inflammation can damage healthy tissue.
concepts.card: Inflammation recruits responses to damaged tissue, supporting repair; when it persists, those responses can also damage healthy tissue.
concepts.original_description: signs of activation of the immune system

evidence.note: NCI contrasts a resolving repair process with prolonged inflammation.
The text explicitly places inflammation within innate immunity while distinguishing injury from infection.

relations.note: The text explicitly calls inflammation a hallmark of the innate immune response.

imported_records.description: signs of activation of the immune system

concepts.label: Karst
concepts.learning_takeaway: Slightly acidic water dissolves soluble rock, producing karst features such as caves and sinkholes.
